def transform3(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    anchor=min(i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==8)
    for c in sorted({v for r in g for v in r}-{0}):
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        top=min(i for i,j in cells)
        for i,j in cells: out[i-top+anchor][j]=c
    return out
